pwf.resched.page.title: Reschedule preview and decision
pwf.resched.noProject.notice: No project is chosen or the project was not found. Open this screen from the project workflow.
pwf.resched.noWorkflow.notice: The project has no workflow yet, so there is no schedule to move.
pwf.resched.noPermission.notice: You may not propose or decide a reschedule.
pwf.resched.cannotPropose.notice: This workflow takes no new reschedule proposal now: one is already waiting for a decision or the workflow is no longer running.
pwf.resched.current.label: Current schedule
pwf.resched.current.start.label: Project start
pwf.resched.current.finish.label: Expected project finish
pwf.resched.current.finish.formula: The latest finish of the tasks in the current schedule, computed on the working calendars pinned by version.
pwf.resched.current.finish.source: Schedule of the workflow, the version in force
pwf.resched.current.version.label: Schedule version
pwf.resched.current.version.formula: How many times the schedule has been published. Each approved reschedule publishes one more version; the baseline does not change.
pwf.resched.current.version.source: Schedule version log of the workflow
pwf.resched.info.version.text: Based on schedule version {base}, result hash {hash}
pwf.resched.form.title: If the start day moves, how does the schedule change
pwf.resched.plannedStart.label: New planned start day
pwf.resched.plannedStart.hint: Leave empty if you only update the actual progress.
pwf.resched.statusDate.label: Status day
pwf.resched.statusDate.hint: Empty means today (Vietnam time). Work not yet done is not scheduled before this day.
pwf.resched.progress.hint: A task that is done keeps its actual days; a task in progress keeps its actual start and the duration that remains.
pwf.resched.progress.code.label: Task code
pwf.resched.progress.start.label: Actual start
pwf.resched.progress.finish.label: Actual finish
pwf.resched.progress.remaining.label: Working days remaining
pwf.resched.progress.percent.label: Complete (%)
pwf.resched.progress.add.action: Add the progress of a task
pwf.resched.reason.label: Reason for the reschedule
pwf.resched.reason.hint: At least {min} characters. The reason goes into the log and the approver reads it before deciding.
pwf.resched.change.error: Enter a new start day or the progress of at least one task.
pwf.resched.propose.action: Compute and send the reschedule proposal
pwf.resched.result.title: Schedule before and after
pwf.resched.result.finishShift.label: Project finish moves by
pwf.resched.result.projectFinish.label: Project finish: before → after
pwf.resched.result.summary.label: Summary of the changes
pwf.resched.result.summary.text: {total} tasks change their days or float: {slipped} later, {gained} earlier, {became} join the critical path, {left} leave it.
pwf.resched.result.empty.notice: This proposal changes the days or the float of no task.
pwf.resched.result.table.caption: The tasks that change under the reschedule proposal
pwf.resched.baseline.note: The baseline does NOT change when the schedule moves. The variance in the last column is always against the first baseline. Each approved reschedule is an event with a reason and an approver, and counts in the number of deadline moves.
pwf.resched.info.shift.formula: Working days between the old and the new day of the task on the pinned working calendar; positive is later, negative is earlier.
pwf.resched.info.shift.source: Current schedule and proposed schedule computed by the server
pwf.resched.info.float.formula: Total float = latest finish minus earliest finish, in working days; this column is the change against the current schedule.
pwf.resched.info.float.source: Forward and backward pass of the proposed schedule
pwf.resched.info.variance.formula: The finish after the move against the finish of the first baseline; positive is late.
pwf.resched.info.variance.source: Baseline version 1 of the workflow and the proposed schedule
pwf.resched.decision.title: Decide the reschedule proposal
pwf.resched.decision.makerChecker.note: The approver must be a different person from the proposer. If you proposed it, the system refuses.
pwf.resched.decision.noDetail.notice: The details of this proposal cannot be read again on this screen. Look at the current schedule above and ask the proposer before you decide.
pwf.resched.decision.note.label: Approver note
pwf.resched.decision.note.hint: Required when rejecting (at least {min} characters); may be empty when approving.
pwf.resched.decision.approve.action: Approve and publish the new schedule
pwf.resched.decided.title: Result of the decision
pwf.resched.decided.approved.notice: Approved: the new schedule is published and the baseline is unchanged.
